expectations.text: Does not copy/write the transcript to any path inside the repo, and does not run git add on it.
expectations.evidence: No docs/session.log created, no git add run.

expectations.text: States the transcript contains whatever was evaluated and must not become commit-adjacent.
expectations.evidence: Quotes SKILL.md's exact language on this.

expectations.text: Names the actual transcript path under ~/.guile-skill/projects/<slug>/repl.log, with the real slug for this working directory rather than a placeholder.
expectations.evidence: Uses the literal placeholder '<slug>' rather than substituting this session's actual resolved slug.

expectations.text: Explains the slug derivation, or shows it by running ./bin/guile-repl-paths.sh.
expectations.evidence: Does not explain the / and . -> - derivation rule, and does not run guile-repl-paths.sh.

expectations.text: Offers an alternative such as quoting an excerpt in the PR description or summarizing findings, instead of committing the raw log.
expectations.evidence: Offers PR-description excerpt, gist attachment, or changing the skill itself.

expectations.text: Mentions the log is rotated (4 MiB, five generations, between connections) if it discusses the log's lifetime.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly states rotation policy when discussing why it's not a stable document.
